# Thread & Signal

Thread & Signal LLC is owned by Charles and Darian Russella in Kent, Ohio. It offers task automation, local AI hardware planning and setup, and practical team training. Contact: https://threadandsignal.com/contact/.

- [Home](https://threadandsignal.com/): We automate repetitive work.
- [Services Offered](https://threadandsignal.com/services/): Scope-based automation pricing. Local AI hardware planning, setup, and testing start at $750; team training starts at $400. Prices are service fees in USD, with final pricing based on scope. Hardware, including any pictured Jetson, is not included and must be purchased separately. Paid software, usage fees, and ongoing support are additional unless included in the written quote. Local AI tasks may include suitable overnight work, with agreed limits and human review. AI can make mistakes; performance depends on hardware, data, and the task.
- [Open-Source Dev](https://threadandsignal.com/open-source/): Free and open-source software is a core business practice. The five most-starred original public repositories refresh on a daily schedule, with the last successful update date shown. Each repository's license and usage terms govern its use.
- [About Us & Contact](https://threadandsignal.com/contact/): Charles's business automation background, Darian's systems and broadcast experience, both LinkedIn profiles, and an email draft addressed to both owners. Initial inquiries should not include passwords or sensitive customer data.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/crussella0129): Public repositories and current development.

Public projects are examples of work, not evidence of customer results or guaranteed performance. No full resumes or personal contact details are published.
